pulse.text: **Gemini 3.5 Pro finally has a date.** After two slips, multiple trackers and a Polymarket projection now peg Google's next flagship for **July 17**, following a scrapped base model and a ground-up retrain for math and coding; the by-July-31 market sits at **91%**. The other clock runs out tomorrow: **OpenAI's GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna) goes broadly public July 9** across API, ChatGPT and Codex, after Commerce lifted its export/safety hold. Standings are unchanged — **Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 still leads the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 60** (v4.1), ahead of Opus 4.8 (56), GPT-5.5 (55) and Sonnet 5 (53) — while Polymarket's 'best model end of July' firmed to **~89% Anthropic** and the year-end race holds at Anthropic 63% / Google 15%; GPT-6 by December sits at 71%. Watch next: whether GPT-5.6's Thursday rollout lands on time and where it slots on the index, then Gemini 3.5 Pro's July 17 target.
